quoteEn: You cannot be lonely if you like the person you're alone with.

author: 韦恩·戴尔
quoteCn: 他人待你如何，是他们的修行；你如何回应，才是你自己的道场。
quoteEn: How people treat you is their karma; how you react is yours.

author: 韦恩·戴尔
quoteCn: 别让你的生命之歌，只在心底独自回响，未曾奏响便已消逝。
quoteEn: Don't die with your music still in you.

author: 威尔·法瑞尔
quoteCn: 我被困在情绪的透明牢笼里，一切都看得见，却什么也触碰不到。
quoteEn: I'm in a glass case of emotion!

author: 威尔·罗杰斯
quoteCn: 如果天堂里没有狗狗，那我宁愿追随它们，去往它们所在的地方。
quoteEn: If there are no dogs in Heaven, then when I die I want to go where they went.

author: 华盛顿·欧文
quoteCn: 刻薄的性情，从不因岁月而温柔，而那尖锐的言语，却是唯一一种，在反复使用中，愈发锋利的刃。
quoteEn: A tart temper never mellows with age, and a sharp tongue is the only edged tool that grows keener with constant use.

author: 威尔·罗杰斯
quoteCn: 如果你总是行色匆匆，那恰恰是在虚掷光阴。
quoteEn: If you are in a hurry, you are wasting your time.

author: 威尔·法瑞尔
quoteCn: 若你无法与自己开怀一笑，这漫漫人生，便会显得格外冗长。
quoteEn: If you can’t laugh at yourself, life’s gonna seem a whole lot longer.

author: 威尔·罗杰斯
quoteCn: 我们不必都成为舞台中央的英雄，总要有人在路边，为那些闪耀的生命，献上最真挚的掌声。
quoteEn: We can’t all be heroes because somebody has to sit on the curb and applaud when they go by.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 我必须亲手铸就我的世界，否则，便只能在他人设定的牢笼中苟活。
quoteEn: I must create a system, or be enslav'd by another man's.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 想象力并非某种短暂的状态，它就是我们之所以为人的存在本身。
quoteEn: The imagination is not a state: it is the human existence itself.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 爱，从不为取悦自身而生。
quoteEn: Love seeketh not itself to please.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 一粒沙中窥见浩瀚世界，一朵野花中感受无垠天堂。
quoteEn: To see a World in a Grain of Sand, And a Heaven in a Wild Flower.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 每个夜幕低垂，每个晨光熹微，总有灵魂注定与苦难相遇。
quoteEn: Every Night and every Morn, Some to Misery are born.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 恶意包裹的真相，其杀伤力远超所有精心编织的谎言。
quoteEn: A truth that's told with bad intent Beats all the Lies you can invent.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 人将自己囚禁于狭隘的洞穴，从此，万物皆是缝隙中透出的微光。
quoteEn: For man has closed himself up, till he sees all things thro' narrow chinks of his cavern.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 通往智慧的殿堂，往往需要我们先走过一段放纵、甚至有些偏离的旅程。
quoteEn: The road of excess leads to the palace of wisdom.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 艺术若无爱意滋养，终难触及灵魂深处。
quoteEn: Art can never be good, unless it is in the spirit of love.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 若感知的门扉被拂拭一新，万物便会以其本来的面貌，那无限的姿态，向人全然敞开。
quoteEn: If the doors of perception were cleansed, everything would appear to man as it is, infinite.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 慈悲、爱与怜悯栖息之地，亦是神性光辉照耀之所。
quoteEn: Where Mercy, Love, and Pity dwell, There God is dwelling too.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 诗歌，是灵魂深处的一场宁静，一次与世界温柔的和解。
quoteEn: Poetry is an act of peace.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 若要活出真我，必先挣脱束缚，不随波逐流。
quoteEn: He who would be a man must be a non-conformist.

author: 威廉·布莱克
quoteCn: 心之所不存，目之所不见。这不仅仅是物理的遮蔽，更是意识的过滤，是灵魂深处对世界的选择性感知。你所关注的，塑造了你所看见的。
quoteEn: What is not in the mind is out of sight.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 我将在那里寻得片刻安宁，因为真正的平静，总是姗姗来迟，如露珠般缓缓坠落。
quoteEn: And I shall have some peace there, for peace comes dropping slow.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 兼得智慧与爱，是凡人难以企及的奢望。
quoteEn: To be wise and love exceeds man's might

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 盘旋复盘旋于渐宽的漩涡，猎鹰已然听不见驯鹰人的召唤。这何尝不是我们，在生命的洪流中越飞越远，渐渐失却了来时的方向，也听不见那些曾经指引我们的声音？
quoteEn: Turning and turning in the widening gyre, the falcon cannot hear the falconer.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 人心，永无餍足之日。
quoteEn: The heart of man is never satisfied.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 那些真正优秀的人，往往对世事抱持着一份清明的怀疑与不确定，不轻易被任何教条束缚；反倒是那些最糟糕的，却总是被盲目的狂热与偏执所充斥。
quoteEn: The best lack all convictions, while the worst are full of passionate intensity.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 我曾深信，人性本善，对世间万物抱以最纯粹的善意。
quoteEn: I have believed the best of every man.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 与外界的争执，让我们学会了言辞的技巧；而与内心的挣扎，却淬炼出我们生命的诗篇。
quoteEn: Out of the quarrel with others we make rhetoric; out of the quarrel with ourselves we make poetry.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 我不过是参天大树下的一抹微影，渺小却也承载着它的过往与未来。
quoteEn: I am no more than a shadow of a mighty tree.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 重要的并非你如何定义世界，而是世界如何塑造了你。
quoteEn: What matters is not the idea a man has of the world, but what the world has of him.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 人生，就是一场漫无止境的准备，为了那些，从未真正降临的时刻。
quoteEn: Life is a long preparation for something that never happens.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 灵魂，生来就是一场奔赴自由的炽热激情。
quoteEn: The soul is a passion to be free.

author: 威廉·巴特勒·叶芝
quoteCn: 十五岁的容颜，是天赐的馈赠，无需你我邀功。可若七十载光阴流转，你依然风华绝代，那份美丽，定是灵魂深处，一笔一划雕琢出的杰作。
quoteEn: You can’t take any credit for beauty at fifteen. But if you are beautiful at seventy, it will be your soul’s own doing.

author: 威廉·格莱斯顿
quoteCn: 世间最伟大的天赋，莫过于女性心中那份深藏的智慧与温柔。
quoteEn: There is no greater genius than the one in a woman’s heart.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 多少人自以为在深思熟虑，不过是把偏见换个位置，继续固执己见。
quoteEn: A great many people think they are thinking when they are merely rearranging their prejudices.

author: 威廉·格莱斯顿
quoteCn: 真正伟大的人，是那些无论世事如何变迁，依然能保有内心那份纯真与好奇的人。
quoteEn: A great man is the one who never loses his child’s heart.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 请你相信，生命值得你为之付出，这份坚定的信念，终将为你铺就真实的道路。
quoteEn: Believe that life is worth living and your belief will help create the fact.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 真正的智慧，是懂得何时温柔地放下，让那些不重要的喧嚣，随风而逝。
quoteEn: The art of being wise is the art of knowing what to overlook.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 我们如海中孤岛，水面之上各自独立，然于深邃海底，却脉络相连，息息相通。
quoteEn: We are like islands in the sea, separate on the surface but connected in the deep.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 世间最深重的苦楚，莫过于那颗除了犹豫，再无其他定势的心。
quoteEn: There is no more miserable person than one in whom nothing is habitual but indecision.

author: 威廉·里昂·菲尔普斯
quoteCn: 幸福，是当你能直面内心深处，而不再感到一丝恐惧。
quoteEn: To be happy is to be able to become aware of oneself without fright.

author: 威廉·里昂·菲尔普斯
quoteCn: 别因为能做的微不足道，就选择袖手旁观。要知道，最大的遗憾，往往源于我们对微小行动的轻视。
quoteEn: It is the greatest of all mistakes to do nothing because you can only do little.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 我的思绪，即我本身；我的思绪，亦是这浩瀚世界。
quoteEn: My thinking is myself, and my thinking is the world.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 真爱之路，何曾坦荡？它总是蜿蜒曲折，充满考验。
quoteEn: The course of true love never did run smooth.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 是存在，还是消逝：这，才是真正的叩问。
quoteEn: To be, or not to be: that is the question.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 这世间，不过是一座大舞台，而我们，男男女女，皆是粉墨登场的戏中人。
quoteEn: All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 万事皆空，唯有真我永恒。忠于你的灵魂，胜过一切浮华。
quoteEn: This above all: to thine own self be true.

author: 威廉·里昂·菲尔普斯
quoteCn: 我们所见的，并非世界的本来面目，而是我们内心的投射。
quoteEn: We don't see things as they are; we see them as we are.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 玫瑰，无论唤作何名，其芬芳依旧，本真不改。
quoteEn: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 熄灭吧，熄灭吧，这短暂的烛光！生命，不过是徘徊游走的幻影。
quoteEn: Out, out brief candle! Life's but a walking shadow.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 离别，是如此甘美的忧伤。
quoteEn: Parting is such sweet sorrow.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 我非我，我亦是我。在面具与真实之间，我们都是一场永恒的追寻。
quoteEn: I am not what I am.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 如果音乐是爱的食粮，那就让它永不停止地奏响吧。
quoteEn: If music be the food of love, play on.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 愚者自诩洞明，智者却深知自身之浅薄。
quoteEn: A fool thinks himself to be wise, but a wise man knows himself to be a fool.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 因为在那死亡的沉睡中，谁又知道会有怎样的梦境悄然降临呢？
quoteEn: For in that sleep of death what dreams may come.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 亲爱的布鲁图斯，错不在星辰，而在我们自己。
quoteEn: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 既成之事，无法逆转。那些已然发生，已然逝去的，我们只能学着放下。
quoteEn: What's done cannot be undone.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 那些深爱自然的心，从未被她辜负。
quoteEn: Nature never did betray the heart that loved her.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 我独自游荡，像一朵失群的云。
quoteEn: I wandered lonely as a cloud

author: 威廉·莎士比亚
quoteCn: 爱，非眼所见，乃心所感。故，那生翼的丘比特，才被描绘成盲目。
quoteEn: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind, and therefore is winged Cupid painted blind.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 于我，那最卑微的绽放，亦能唤醒深藏心底，连泪水都无法触及的思绪。
quoteEn: To me, the meanest flower that blows can give thoughts that do often lie too deep for tears.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 一个良善之人，其生命中最动人的篇章，往往是那些微不足道、不求回报、甚至无人知晓的善意与爱。
quoteEn: The best portion of a good man's life: his little, nameless, unremembered acts of kindness and of love.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 天堂的微光，曾是我们童年最纯粹的底色。
quoteEn: Heaven lies about us in our infancy!

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 爱，以其磅礴之力，予人以深沉的慰藉。
quoteEn: There is a comfort in the strength of love.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 智慧，往往在我们低头沉思时，比在志得意满、高飞远扬时，更悄然靠近。
quoteEn: Wisdom is oft-times nearer when we stoop than when we soar.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 洞察入微者，未必言辞斐然。
quoteEn: Those who are best at seeing, are not always those who are best at speaking.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 我所拥有的，仅此一生；而这一生，已然丰盛。
quoteEn: The life I have is all I have, and the life I have is enough.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 你知道吗，我总觉得，我们穷尽一生，不过是为了学会如何真正成为自己。
quoteEn: You know, I think our whole life is about learning how to be yourself.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 若心不在当下，你便是在憧憬未知的迷雾，或沉湎于过往的伤痛与悔恨。
quoteEn: If you aren't in the moment, you are either looking forward to uncertainty, or back to pain and regret.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 音乐，就像一场深情的爱恋，让人沉醉，也让人心碎。
quoteEn: I think that the music is a little bit like a love affair.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 我们都在这趟人生的旅程中，彼此相依。
quoteEn: We’re all in this life together.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 我想，我们都一样，在爱里沉沦，又在爱里清醒。循环往复，是人生的常态。
quoteEn: That's what I think we all do, you know, we fall in love and out of love.

author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
quoteCn: 我们汲汲营营，为生存而索取；我们慷慨付出，为生命而丰盛。
quoteEn: We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 这世上，总有人急于将你定义，把你困于他们所设的方寸之间。
quoteEn: The world is full of people who want to put you in a box.

author: 伍德罗·威尔逊
quoteCn: 只有逆流而上的人，才真正懂得那股力量的强大与不易。
quoteEn: The man who is swimming against the stream knows the strength of it.

author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
quoteCn: 我们皆凡尘微粒，但吾心深信，我自是那点亮夜色的流萤。
quoteEn: We are all worms. But I do believe that I am a glow-worm.

author: 伍德罗·威尔逊
quoteCn: 你来到这世间，绝非只为糊口度日。
quoteEn: You are not here merely to make a living.

author: 伍德罗·威尔逊
quoteCn: 自由，是允许你心生疑虑的余地。
quoteEn: Liberty is the possibility of doubting.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 我们穷尽一生，不过是在寻觅一个活着的意义。
quoteEn: We’re all just trying to find a reason to live.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 死亡，我并不畏惧。只是，当它降临，我愿缺席。
quoteEn: I'm not afraid of death; I just don't want to be there when it happens.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 生命啊，尽是苦楚、孤寂与煎熬——可它偏偏，又如此匆匆地逝去。
quoteEn: Life is full of misery, loneliness, and suffering - and it's all over much too soon.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 如果你想让命运莞尔一笑，不妨轻声细语你的宏图伟愿。
quoteEn: If you want to make God laugh, tell him your plans.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 在你眼中，我或许是无神论者；但在神明面前，我却是忠诚的异议者。
quoteEn: To you, I’m an atheist. To God, I’m the Loyal Opposition.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 所谓道德义愤，不过是嫉妒心戴上了神圣的光环。
quoteEn: Moral indignation is jealousy with a halo.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 此生最幸，莫过于寻得一人，深爱着你，不加修饰，不带伪装，只为你最本真的模样。
quoteEn: The best thing you can do is find a person who loves you for exactly what you are.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 我并非畏惧死亡本身，只是不愿亲历它发生的那一刻。
quoteEn: It's not that I'm afraid to die, I just don't want to be there when it happens.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 我此生唯一的遗憾，是未能成为另一个人。这句看似荒诞的自嘲，实则深藏着对自我局限的无奈与渴望超越的挣扎，它触及了我们内心深处对“如果我是另一个人会怎样”的永恒追问。
quoteEn: My one regret in life is that I am not someone else.

author: 伍迪·艾伦
quoteCn: 我不知所措，只是在这世间游荡。
quoteEn: I don’t know what I’m doing, I’m just wandering through life.

author: 尤吉·贝拉
quoteCn: 这似曾相识的轮回，又一次上演。
quoteEn: "It's déjà vu all over again."

author: 尤吉·贝拉
quoteCn: 未来，它已不再是往昔的模样。那些曾以为的确定，如今都成了风中之尘。
quoteEn: The future ain't what it used to be.

author: 威廉·华兹华斯
quoteCn: 我们的诞生，不过是漫长沉睡的延续，与过往的遗忘。
quoteEn: Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting.

author: 威利·尼尔森
quoteCn: 我可以走进夜色喧嚣，轻声问候，然后悄然退场，不留一丝痕迹。
quoteEn: I can go to a nightclub and say, 'Hello,' and then leave and just disappear.

author: 威廉·里昂·菲尔普斯
quoteCn: 生命的意义，在于全然地投入，去淋漓尽致地品尝每一次经历。
quoteEn: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost.

author: 威廉·詹姆斯
quoteCn: 若要世界归序，必先经历混沌。这并非破坏，而是重塑的序章，是旧有格局被打破后，新生的契机。
quoteEn: To put the world in order, we must first put the world in disorder.

author: 年轻的多尔夫
quoteCn: 你无法改变那些你拒绝正视的真相。
quoteEn: You can’t change what you don’t acknowledge.

author: 年轻的多尔夫
quoteCn: 我自泥泞深处而来，饱尝挣扎的滋味。
quoteEn: I come from the bottom, I come from the struggle.

author: 杨博
quoteCn: 你终将学会，与自己和解，成为此生最亲密的挚友。
quoteEn: You gotta learn to be your own best friend.

author: 齐格·齐格勒
quoteCn: 阻碍你的，从来不是你真实的样子，而是你执着于自己“不是”的样子。
quoteEn: It's not what you are that holds you back, it's what you think you are not.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 真理，是时间温柔的馈赠，而非权威冰冷的宣判。
quoteEn: Truth is the daughter of time, not of authority.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 最深的孤独，并非独处，而是身陷人群却无至交，心无所依。
quoteEn: The worst solitude is to be destitute of sincere friendship.

author: 齐格·齐格勒
quoteCn: 失败，不过是一段经历，而非你的全部。
quoteEn: Failure is an event, not a person.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 希望如清晨的微光，唤醒你一天的生机；但若执着于此，它也可能成为深夜的寒意，让你难以安眠。
quoteEn: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 人的理解，从来不是一盏冰冷的明灯，它被我们的意志和情感，深深地浸润着，染上了我们生命的色彩。
quoteEn: The human understanding is no dry light, but receives an infusion from the will and affections.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 一个人，被世界熟知，却终其一生，未曾与真正的自己相遇，这何尝不是一种深刻的悲哀。
quoteEn: It is a sad fate for a man to die too well known to everybody else, and still unknown to himself.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 那些沉溺于复仇的人啊，其实是亲手让自己的伤口，永不结痂。
quoteEn: A man that studieth revenge keeps his own wounds green.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 父母的欢愉深藏不露，他们的悲苦与忧惧，亦是如此，无声无息。
quoteEn: The joys of parents are secret, and so are their griefs and fears.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 圣灵之笔，在约伯的苦难中倾注了远超所罗门幸福的笔墨。因为，苦难的深邃，远比幸福的浮光掠影，更能触及灵魂的底色。
quoteEn: The pencil of the Holy Ghost hath labored more in describing the afflictions of Job than the felicities of Solomon.

author: 弗朗西斯·培根
quoteCn: 繁盛并非没有隐忧与倦怠，而困顿之中，亦不乏慰藉与希望的微光。
quoteEn: Prosperity is not without many fears and distastes; and adversity is not without comforts and hopes.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 我步伐缓慢，但每一步都向前，从不退缩。
quoteEn: I walk slowly, but I never walk backward.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 未来最动人的，莫过于它总是循序渐进，一日一日地向我们走来。
quoteEn: The best thing about the future is that it comes one day at a time.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 我并非注定要赢，但我必须忠于真实。我并非注定要成功，但我必须活出我内心那束光。
quoteEn: I am not bound to win, but I am bound to be true. I am not bound to succeed, but I am bound to live by the light that I have.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 那些在平静岁月里被奉为圭臬的信条，已无法承载此刻风暴骤起的现实。
quoteEn: The dogmas of the quiet past are inadequate to the stormy present.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 我所忧虑的，并非上苍是否眷顾我等；我所深切关怀的，是我等是否与道义同行。
quoteEn: My concern is not whether God is on our side; my greatest concern is to be on God's side.

author: 亚当·格兰特
quoteCn: 越是汲汲于幸福，幸福越是遥不可及。
quoteEn: The more you value happiness, the less you achieve it.

author: 亚伯拉罕·林肯
quoteCn: 我步伐缓慢，却从不倒退。
quoteEn: I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 犯错是人性的必然，而宽恕，则是灵魂深处的神性光辉。
quoteEn: To err is human; to forgive, divine.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 最可怕的疯癫，莫过于一位圣人失却了心智。
quoteEn: The worst of madmen is a saint run mad.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 饥饿的法官草草落笔，可怜的生命就此终结，只为陪审员能安心享用一顿饭。这世间的悲凉，有时不过是权力与冷漠的轻描淡写。
quoteEn: The hungry judges soon the sentence sign, and wretches hang that jurymen may dine.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 认识你自己，别妄图揣测神明；因为人类最深奥、最值得探究的，终究是人类自己。
quoteEn: Know then thyself, presume not God to scan; the proper study of mankind is man.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 灵魂深处的宁静微光，以及那份由衷的喜悦，是美德最终的馈赠。
quoteEn: The soul’s calm sunshine and the heartfelt joy, is virtue’s prize.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 自然万物皆是艺术，只是你未曾察觉；所有偶然与指引，你都未能洞悉。
quoteEn: All nature is but art, unknown to thee; all chance, direction, which thou canst not see.

author: 艾伦·凯
quoteCn: 换个角度看世界，你将拥有超越80个智商点的智慧。
quoteEn: Perspective is worth 80 IQ points.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 清晨赞颂的，夜晚却可能唾弃，人啊，总以为最终的见解才是真理。
quoteEn: Some praise at morning what they blame at night, but always think the last opinion right.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 世间最能洞察秋毫的，莫过于我们审视自身过失时，那双饱含自省的眼眸。
quoteEn: The greatest magnifying glasses in the world are a man’s own eyes when they look upon his own errors.

author: 亚历山大·波普
quoteCn: 承认昨日之失，并非耻辱，而是宣告：今日之我，已胜昨日。
quoteEn: A man should never be ashamed to own he has been in the wrong, which is but saying, in other words, that he is wiser today than he was yesterday.

author: 安德鲁·格罗夫
quoteCn: 那些曾被时代光环笼罩的人，往往最难转身，最不愿放下昔日的辉煌，去拥抱未知的潮汐。
quoteEn: The person who is the star of a previous era is often the last one to adapt to change, and the last one to let go of what made them successful.

author: 安-劳尔·勒·昆夫
quoteCn: 你所处的环境，比你以为的意志力，更能无声地雕刻你的行为轨迹。
quoteEn: Your environment shapes your behavior more than your willpower.

author: 安-劳尔·勒·昆夫
quoteCn: 正念，不是要你强行清空脑海，而是温柔地与每一个念头同在，不评判，不抗拒。
quoteEn: Mindfulness is not about emptying your mind; it’s about being present with your thoughts.

author: 安-劳尔·勒·昆夫
quoteCn: 你的习惯，是你生命中那些不被察觉，却又无处不在的温柔支柱。
quoteEn: Your habits are the invisible architecture of your life.

author: 亚里士多德
quoteCn: 生命的至高价值，不在于苟延残喘，而在于清醒的觉察与深刻的沉思。
quoteEn: The ultimate value of life depends upon awareness and the power of contemplation rather than upon mere survival.

author: 亚里士多德
quoteCn: 感知，即是受苦的开始。
quoteEn: To perceive is to suffer.

author: 亚里士多德
quoteCn: 灵魂的思绪，总在画面中流淌。
quoteEn: The soul never thinks without a picture.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 宇宙之奇，远超我们所能想象的边界，甚至超越了想象本身。
quoteEn: Not only is the universe stranger than we imagine, it is stranger than we can imagine.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 世界的本源，是意识的流淌。
quoteEn: The stuff of the world is mind-stuff.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 我们在未知的海岸边，发现了一枚陌生的足迹。它或许属于我们，或许属于更广阔的宇宙，但无论如何，都指向了那份深邃的未知与无尽的探索。
quoteEn: We have found a strange footprint on the shores of the unknown.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 我们是偶然冷却的星尘，是那颗偏离轨道的星辰碎片。我们本是宇宙的炽热，却不期然地冷却，带着一丝迷惘，一丝与生俱来的疏离。
quoteEn: We are bits of stellar matter that got cold by accident, bits of a star gone wrong.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 世界并非一成不变的实相，而是一个永恒流转、生生不息的历程。
quoteEn: The world is not a universe of being, but a universe of becoming.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 宇宙并非冰冷的物质堆砌，而是意义流淌的所在。
quoteEn: The universe is not a universe of matter, but a universe of meaning.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 宇宙，并非由孤立的物事堆砌，而是由无尽的关联与牵绊编织而成。
quoteEn: The universe is a universe of relations, not of things.

author: 阿瑟·爱丁顿
quoteCn: 宇宙并非静止的实体，而是一场永不停歇的、流动的生命之旅。
quoteEn: The universe is a universe of process, not of being.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 当思绪在心底盘桓，不与人言，它便如同一座拥挤的迷宫，让人寸步难行。
quoteEn: Your brain gets too crowded when you keep your ideas to yourself.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 你，被允许随时改变心意，无需抱歉。
quoteEn: You’re allowed to change your mind.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 别等看清自己才启程，就在迷雾中出发吧。
quoteEn: Don’t wait until you know who you are to get started.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 那些塑造你的，并非定义你的。你，远比你所受的影响更广阔。
quoteEn: Your influences are not your identity.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 你选择放下的一切，都将成为你所珍视的，最清晰的注脚。
quoteEn: The more you leave out, the more you highlight what you leave in.

author: 奥斯丁·克里昂
quoteCn: 那些你总在拖延时偷偷溜去做的事，也许才是你灵魂深处真正渴望，并值得你用余生去奔赴的。
quoteEn: The work you do while you procrastinate is probably the work you should be doing for the rest of your life.

author: 本杰明·富兰克林
quoteCn: 房子，若无精神食粮与灵魂之火，便只是一处居所，而非归宿。
quoteEn: A house is not a home unless it contains food and fire for the mind as well as the body.

author: 本杰明·格雷厄姆
quoteCn: 投资者最大的困境，甚至是他最可怕的对手，往往不是市场，而是他内心的那个自己。
quoteEn: The investor’s chief problem—and even his worst enemy—is likely to be himself.

author: 本杰明·富兰克林
quoteCn: 即便最显赫的君王，坐拥至高无上的宝座，也终究要回归凡身，坐于自己的肉体之上。
quoteEn: The greatest monarch on the proudest throne is obliged to sit upon his own arse.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 这世上所有的困扰，都源于愚者与狂热者那份不容置疑的笃定，而智者，却总被无尽的疑虑所困。
quoteEn: The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, and wiser people so full of doubts.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 畏惧爱，即是畏惧生命本身。而那些对生命心生畏惧的人，他们的灵魂早已枯萎大半。
quoteEn: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 幸福的秘诀，在于坦然接受这世界，本就如此可怖，可怖，可怖。
quoteEn: The secret to happiness is to face the fact that the world is horrible, horrible, horrible.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 战争从不裁定正义，它只清点幸存的灵魂。
quoteEn: War does not determine who is right—only who is left.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 父亲的深层症结在于，他们往往将子女视为自身荣耀的延伸。
quoteEn: The fundamental defect of fathers is that they want their children to be a credit to them.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 这世间充满奇迹，它们只是静静地等待，直到我们的心智足够澄澈，足以将它们一一辨明。
quoteEn: The world is full of magical things patiently waiting for our wits to grow sharper.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 在生命的旅途中，偶尔停下来，给那些我们曾深信不疑、习以为常的一切，轻轻挂上一个问号，这本身就是一种疗愈的清醒。
quoteEn: In all affairs, it's a healthy thing now and then to hang a question mark on the things you have long taken for granted.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 这世间的症结，在于愚者总能笃定前行，而智者却步履维艰，满心疑虑。
quoteEn: The fundamental cause of the trouble is that in the modern world the stupid are cocksure while the intelligent are full of doubt.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 面对这不自由的尘世，唯一的解脱之道，是活出全然的自由，让你的存在本身，成为最无声却最有力的反抗。
quoteEn: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion.

author: 比尔·布赖森
quoteCn: 我们，说到底，是一个无法被定义的物种。
quoteEn: We are, in short, an impossible species.

author: 比尔·布赖森
quoteCn: 我们栖居于一个宇宙，它在无尽扩张中，亦在寂静衰亡里。
quoteEn: We live in a universe that is simultaneously expanding and dying.

author: 伯特兰·拉塞尔
quoteCn: 三种看似寻常却又势不可挡的激情，贯穿我的一生：对爱的深切渴望，对真知的无尽追寻，以及对人类苦难那份刻骨铭心的悲悯。
quoteEn: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.

author: 卡尔·纽波特
quoteCn: 独处匮乏：一种现代病症，你几乎没有片刻能与自己的思绪独处，灵魂被他人的喧嚣填满，再无缝隙。
quoteEn: Solitude Deprivation: A state in which you spend close to zero time alone with your own thoughts and free from input from other minds.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们，是生命意义的掌灯人。
quoteEn: We are the custodians of life's meaning.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们如朝生暮死的蝶，振翅一日，却误以为是永恒。
quoteEn: We are like butterflies who flutter for a day and think it is forever.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们是星辰的碎片，汲取着阳光的馈赠。
quoteEn: We are star-stuff harvesting sunlight.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 想象力，它常引我们抵达那些未曾存在的彼岸。可若无它，我们便寸步难行，困于此地。
quoteEn: Imagination will often carry us to worlds that never were. But without it, we go nowhere.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们是宇宙，以一种觉醒的姿态，在此刻此地，感知着自身的存在。
quoteEn: We are the local embodiment of a cosmos grown to self-awareness.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 宇宙，它既不温柔以待，亦无恶意相向，只是以一种深邃的冷漠，静默地存在着。
quoteEn: The universe seems neither benign nor hostile, merely indifferent.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们DNA里的氮，牙齿里的钙，血液里的铁，甚至苹果派里的碳，都曾是坍塌星辰深处的火焰。我们，是星尘的孩子。
quoteEn: The nitrogen in our DNA, the calcium in our teeth, the iron in our blood, the carbon in our apple pies were made in the interiors of collapsing stars. We are made of star-stuff.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 书籍，是我们穿越时空的船票，轻触先人智慧的星辰。
quoteEn: Books permit us to voyage through time, to tap the wisdom of our ancestors.

author: 卡罗尔·德韦克
quoteCn: 你如何看待自己，将深刻地雕刻你生命的轨迹。
quoteEn: The view you adopt for yourself profoundly affects the way you lead your life.

author: 卡罗尔·德韦克
quoteCn: 成为，远胜于固守。它关乎生命的流动与无限可能。
quoteEn: Becoming is better than being.

author: 卡罗尔·德韦克
quoteCn: 在僵固的心态里，所有价值都只系于最终的成败。一旦你跌倒，或未能登顶，便觉过往一切，皆成虚无。
quoteEn: In the fixed mindset, everything is about the outcome. If you fail—or if you’re not the best—it’s all been wasted.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 我们，是宇宙在以万物之形，体验着它自己。
quoteEn: We are the universe experiencing itself.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 浩瀚宇宙，亦在我心。我们是星辰的碎片，是宇宙借由我们，洞悉其自身的存在。
quoteEn: The cosmos is within us. We are made of star-stuff. We are a way for the universe to know itself.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 地球，不过是浩瀚宇宙剧场里，一方微尘般的舞台。
quoteEn: The Earth is a very small stage in a vast cosmic arena.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 那是最好的岁月，也是最糟的岁月。
quoteEn: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 世上无人是虚度，只要他曾为他人，分担过一丝重负。
quoteEn: No one is useless in this world who lightens the burdens of another.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 眼泪，从不应是羞耻的印记，而是灵魂深处最真挚的表达。
quoteEn: We need never be ashamed of our tears.

author: 卡尔·萨根
quoteCn: 生命的华美，不在于构成它的微尘，而在于那些微尘如何被温柔地编织、巧妙地聚合。
quoteEn: The beauty of a living thing is not the atoms that go into it, but the way those atoms are put together.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 苦难，以其无声的伟力，超越了所有教诲，让我终于触及并懂得，你那曾饱经风霜的心。
quoteEn: Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching, and has taught me to understand what your heart used to be.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 愿你心底柔软，不被世事磨砺得冷硬；愿你热情不减，不被岁月消磨得疲惫；愿你温柔以待，不经意间伤及他人。
quoteEn: Have a heart that never hardens, and a temper that never tires, and a touch that never hurts.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 我将把圣诞的温暖珍藏于心，并努力让这份光芒照亮我一整年的旅程。
quoteEn: I will honor Christmas in my heart, and try to keep it all the year.

author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
quoteCn: 初升的太阳也曾微弱，但它在白昼的流转中，积蓄起光芒与无畏。
quoteEn: The sun himself is weak when he first rises, and gathers strength and courage as the day gets on.

author: 查尔斯·施瓦布
quoteCn: 那些倾尽全力，且内心澄明无憾的人，即便世俗的眼光将他们定义为失败，他们也已然抵达了成功的彼岸。
quoteEn: The man who has done his level best, and who is conscious that he has done his best, is a success, even though the world may write him down a failure.

author: 查理·芒格
quoteCn: 推动这世界的，从来不是贪婪，而是那深藏不露的嫉妒。
quoteEn: It’s not greed that drives the world, but envy.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我非笼中雀，亦无网可缚。我，是拥有独立意志的自由人。
quoteEn: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me: I am a free human being with an independent will.

author: 查理·芒格
quoteCn: 暮年最坚实的铠甲，是此前每一个认真活过的瞬间。
quoteEn: The best armor of old age is a well-spent life preceding it.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 生命如此短促，怎能虚掷于滋养怨恨，或细数旧账？
quoteEn: Life appears to me too short to be spent in nursing animosity or registering wrongs.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 墨守成规，并非真正的道德；自以为是，更不是信仰的真谛。
quoteEn: Conventionality is not morality. Self-righteousness is not religion.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我宁愿选择快乐，胜过徒有其表的尊严。
quoteEn: I would always rather be happy than dignified.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我珍视自我。越是形单影只，越是无人问津，越是孤立无援，我越要挺直脊梁，尊重自己。
quoteEn: I care for myself. The more solitary, the more friendless, the more unsustained I am, the more I will respect myself.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 人心深处，藏匿着不为人知的宝藏，它们被秘密守护，被静默封存，等待被温柔地发现。
quoteEn: The human heart has hidden treasures, in secret kept, in silence sealed.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我非天使，至死不为。我，只做我自己。
quoteEn: I am not an angel, and I will not be one till I die: I will be myself.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 灵魂，幸而有眼眸作为其无声的译者，它或许不自知，却始终忠诚地映照着内心深处。
quoteEn: The soul, fortunately, has an interpreter—often an unconscious but still a faithful interpreter—in the eye.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 那些无法被分享的幸福，几乎不配拥有幸福之名；它们尝起来，是如此的索然无味啊。
quoteEn: Happiness quite unshared can scarcely be called happiness; it has no taste.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 当灵魂深爱时，它便如花朵般，向着阳光，全然绽放。
quoteEn: The soul, when it loves, is like a flower that opens to the sun.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 若自尊与境遇皆命我独行，我亦能坦然自处。
quoteEn: I can live alone, if self-respect and circumstances require me so to do.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 心，如同一只精巧的匣子，深藏着我们生命中那些闪光的、沉甸甸的记忆珍宝。
quoteEn: The heart is like a casket, and within it are stored the treasures of memory.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 人心深藏着不为人知的奥秘，思绪万千，亦有其不宣于口的秘密。
quoteEn: The human heart has its mysteries, and the human mind its secrets.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 徒劳啊，若要人甘于平静。生命本就该是行动的，若无路可循，他们自会开辟。
quoteEn: It is in vain to say human beings ought to be satisfied with tranquility: they must have action; and they will make it if they cannot find it.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 困扰我的并非单身与否，而是那份挥之不去的孤独感，它如影随形，似乎永无止境。
quoteEn: The trouble is not that I am single and likely to stay single, but that I am lonely and likely to stay lonely.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 愉悦，这看似外在的馈赠，实则与我们内心深处的光景，同等重要地交织在一起。
quoteEn: Cheerfulness, it would appear, is a matter which depends fully as much on the state of things within as on the state of things without and around us.

author: 奇普·希思
quoteCn: 那些看似抗拒的，往往只是因为我们尚未看清方向。
quoteEn: What looks like resistance is often a lack of clarity.

author: 奇普·希思
quoteCn: 事物的核心，往往是心之所向，情之所困。
quoteEn: The heart of the matter is often a matter of the heart.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我并非言不由衷：若我虚伪，便会轻启唇说爱你；但我坦然宣告，我心无此意。
quoteEn: I am not deceitful: if I were, I should say I loved you; but I declare I do not love you.

author: 奇普·希思
quoteCn: 那些最刻骨铭心的，往往是生命中出乎意料的“脱轨”。
quoteEn: The most memorable experiences are often the ones that break the script.

author: 奇普·希思
quoteCn: 当你身处起点，不必为前路中途的迷雾而焦虑，因为当你真正踏足彼时，那风景自会以你意想不到的姿态展开。
quoteEn: When you’re at the beginning, don’t obsess about the middle, because the middle is going to look different once you get there.

author: 查克·菲尼
quoteCn: 我生命中最幸福的时刻，都与慷慨赠予他人紧密相连。
quoteEn: The happiest times in my life were when I was giving money away.

author: 克莱顿·克里斯坦森
quoteCn: 你选择丈量生命的尺度，终将塑就你此生的模样。
quoteEn: The metrics by which you measure your life will determine the kind of life you lead.

author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
quoteCn: 阻碍我真正学习的，恰恰是我所受的教育。
quoteEn: The only thing that interferes with my learning is my education.

author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
quoteCn: 静默的日常与独处的时光，恰是那颗渴望创造的心灵，最深沉的滋养与不竭的源泉。
quoteEn: The monotony and solitude of a quiet life stimulates the creative mind.

author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
quoteCn: 追寻真理与美的旅程，是我们被允许永葆孩童般纯真的游乐场。
quoteEn: The pursuit of truth and beauty is a sphere of activity in which we are permitted to remain children all our lives.

author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
quoteCn: 逻辑，不过是通往已知彼岸的桥梁；而想象，才是那艘驶向无限可能的方舟。
quoteEn: Logic will get you from A to B. Imagination will take you everywhere.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 并非无知本身，而是对自身无知的全然不觉，才是扼杀求知的真正死穴。
quoteEn: Not ignorance, but ignorance of ignorance, is the death of knowledge.

author: 亚历山大·弗莱明
quoteCn: 人生啊，总在不经意间，馈赠你意料之外的惊喜。
quoteEn: One sometimes finds what one is not looking for.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 哲学始于那份纯粹的惊奇。而当所有深思熟虑都已穷尽，那份惊奇，依然如初，永恒地驻留在我们心间。
quoteEn: Philosophy begins in wonder. And, at the end, when philosophic thought has done its best, the wonder remains.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 悲剧的精髓，并非不幸本身，而是万物无情运转的庄严与宿命。它揭示了我们面对不可抗拒的命运时，那份深沉的无力与敬畏。
quoteEn: The essence of dramatic tragedy is not unhappiness. It resides in the solemnity of the remorseless working of things.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 唯有穿越重重繁芜，抵达彼岸的澄澈，才是真正值得托付的简单。
quoteEn: The only simplicity to be trusted is the simplicity to be found on the far side of complexity.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 青春，是生命尚未被悲剧温柔触碰的纯粹时段。
quoteEn: The deepest definition of youth is life as yet untouched by tragedy.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 宇宙并非一座冰冷的博物馆，将生命凝固在玻璃柜中，它是一场永不停歇的流动与创造。
quoteEn: The universe is not a museum with its specimens in glass cases.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 崇敬的根基，在于你我洞察到：此刻，这须臾的当下，已然承载了存在的全部总和，它回溯过往，也预示未来，是时间最完整的振幅，亦是永恒本身。
quoteEn: The foundation of reverence is this perception, that the present holds within itself the complete sum of existence, backwards and forwards, that whole amplitude of time, which is eternity.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 宗教，是灵魂在独处时，与自我进行的深沉对话。
quoteEn: Religion is what the individual does with his own solitariness.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 未来，生来就带着危险的基因。
quoteEn: It is the business of the future to be dangerous.

author: 阿尔弗雷德·诺思·怀特海
quoteCn: 那些看似独立自足的，往往不是我们内心深处真正的自己。
quoteEn: The self-sufficient unit is not the real individual.

author: 阿利斯泰尔·库克
quoteCn: 英国人从不当面撕破脸。他们只是，不再邀请你共进晚餐了。
quoteEn: The English never smash in a face. They merely refrain from asking it to dinner.

author: 阿利斯泰尔·库克
quoteCn: 身陷无休止的奔逐，即便你最终胜出，也不过是只疲惫的老鼠。
quoteEn: The trouble with the rat race is that even if you win, you’re still a rat.

author: 安吉拉·达克沃斯
quoteCn: 热情如潮汐，来去匆匆；唯有坚韧，方能穿越岁月长河，抵达彼岸。
quoteEn: Enthusiasm is common. Endurance is rare.

author: 安吉拉·达克沃斯
quoteCn: 真正的毅力，并非仅是跌倒后爬起的韧劲，更是即便在失败、逆境与停滞不前中，依然能年复一年地，怀抱初心，倾注心力。
quoteEn: Grit is not just about resilience in the face of failure, but also about maintaining effort and interest over years despite failure, adversity, and plateaus in progress.

author: 安吉拉·达克沃斯
quoteCn: 坚毅，并非仅仅是埋头苦干，更是将那份深沉的热爱，化作不懈的耕耘。
quoteEn: Grit is not just about working hard. It’s about working hard on something you love.

author: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎
quoteCn: 当心灵以永恒的眼光审视万物，它便触及了永恒的本质。
quoteEn: Eternal is the mind, inasmuch as it conceives things under the appearance of eternity.

author: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎
quoteCn: 和平并非仅仅是战火的平息，它更是源自我们内心深处那份坚韧不拔的精神力量所绽放出的高贵品格。
quoteEn: Pax is not the absence of war, but the virtue that arises from the strength of the spirit.

author: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎
quoteCn: 自由，是循着你内心最深处的本性，去活出你自己的力量。
quoteEn: Liberty is the power to act according to the laws of one's own nature.

author: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎
quoteCn: 我们所展现的一切，都必然根植于我们内在的真实自我。
quoteEn: Whatever follows from us necessarily follows from what is within us.

author: 巴鲁赫·斯宾诺莎
quoteCn: 情绪，这股涌动的激情，一旦被我们清晰地洞察和理解，便不再是盲目的冲动，而是转变为一份被驯服的能量。
quoteEn: Affectus, which is a passion, ceases to be a passion as soon as we form a clear and distinct idea of it.

author: 布赖恩·克里斯蒂安
quoteCn: 当世界被算法和机器重塑，我们更要深思，何以为人。
quoteEn: The more we automate, the more we need to understand what it means to be human.

author: 布赖恩·克里斯蒂安
quoteCn: 在所有人类的使命中，最深刻的莫过于，在每一个当下，去抉择下一步的方向。
quoteEn: The most human of all tasks is deciding what to do next.

author: 布赖恩·克里斯蒂安
quoteCn: 图灵测试的真正挑战，并非仅仅在于创造一台能以假乱真的机器，而在于我们能否真正洞悉，那份被蒙蔽、被迷惑的深层含义。
quoteEn: The challenge of the Turing Test is not just to build a machine that can fool humans, but to understand what it means to be fooled.

author: 布赖恩·克里斯蒂安
quoteCn: 生而为人，我们都是未完成的诗篇。
quoteEn: To be human is to be a work in progress.

author: 布赖恩·克里斯蒂安
quoteCn: 人性的光辉，不在于我们是否完美无瑕，而在于我们如何拥抱那些不完美。
quoteEn: The essence of being human is not in our perfection, but in our imperfection.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 若连荆棘都不敢触碰，又怎能奢望玫瑰的芬芳？
quoteEn: But he who dares not grasp the thorn should never crave the rose.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 无论我们的灵魂以何为质，你我之间，并无二致。
quoteEn: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我未曾让你心碎，是你亲手将它撕裂；而那破碎的声响，也震碎了我。
quoteEn: I have not broken your heart—you have broken it; and in breaking it, you have broken mine.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 我不能没有我的灵魂而活！
quoteEn: I cannot live without my soul!

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 他比我更懂得我，更像我灵魂的镜子。无论我们的灵魂以何种材质铸就，我和他，本就是同一种存在。
quoteEn: He's more myself than I am. Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.

author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
quoteCn: 背叛与暴力，是刺向自身的双刃矛，伤人亦伤己，且伤己更深。
quoteEn: Treachery and violence are spears pointed at both ends; they wound those who resort to them worse than their enemies.

author: 科琳·鲁尼
quoteCn: 我相信宽恕的力量，但那份释然，往往需要时间的温柔抚慰。
quoteEn: I believe in forgiveness, but it takes time.

author: 科琳·鲁尼
quoteCn: 我为那个在无数挑战中，最终被锻造出来的自己，感到由衷的骄傲。
quoteEn: I’m proud of the person I’ve become through all the challenges.

author: 科尼利厄斯·范德比尔特
quoteCn: 两亿身家，足以耗尽一个人的生命。其中，再无半点欢愉可言。
quoteEn: The care of $200 million is enough to kill anyone. There is no pleasure in it.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂对美的渴求，远胜过对温饱的执念。
quoteEn: The human soul needs actual beauty more than bread.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 真正的正义，是追随灵魂深处那份真挚的直觉，无论它激昂如火，抑或温柔如水。
quoteEn: The only justice is to follow the sincere intuition of the soul, angry or gentle.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂无所指派，它不施令，亦不受令。
quoteEn: The soul has no assignments, it neither directs nor is directed.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 无论多少次天塌地陷，我们都必须，也终将继续活下去。
quoteEn: We’ve got to live, no matter how many skies have fallen.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 人，真是个奇妙的生灵。他以为自己只有一颗灵魂，却不知，体内住着万千个自己。
quoteEn: The human being is a most curious creature. He thinks he has got one soul, and he has got dozens.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 世界从不畏惧新思想，因为它总能将其轻易归类。但它却无法框定一种全新的体验，因为那份鲜活，只属于你。
quoteEn: The world doesn’t fear a new idea. It can pigeonhole any idea. But it can’t pigeonhole a new experience.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 生命是用来燃烧的，不是用来小心翼翼地储藏。
quoteEn: Life is ours to be spent, not to be saved.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 人的灵魂，是一片幽深浩瀚的森林，野性生命在其间涌动。
quoteEn: The human soul is a dark vast forest, with wild life in it.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是衡量万物和谐的至高审判者。
quoteEn: The soul is a very perfect judge of harmonies.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂啊，沉重、笨拙，没有翅膀，像铅块一样坠落。反倒是这具肉身，有时能如此轻盈，如此迅捷。
quoteEn: The human soul is heavy, clumsy, wingless, and leaden. It is the body that is swift and light.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 人的灵魂，是一片幽深的密林。
quoteEn: The human soul is a dark forest.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 唯有灵魂，值得被爱。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be loved.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是这世间唯一值得你穷尽一生去探寻的宝藏。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be found.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是唯一能被深恶痛绝之物，因为它承载着我们最真实的爱与痛。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be hated.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是万物相连的桥梁，是深层意义的低语。
quoteEn: The soul is the great connecter, the great interpreter.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是这世间唯一能真正失落的珍宝。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be lost.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 唯有灵魂，方能得救。它不被世俗所困，不为肉体所累，是那永恒的、值得我们穷尽一生去守护与升华的所在。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be saved.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，唯有在自由的行动与驰骋中，方能真正活出其本真。
quoteEn: The soul must be free to act, to move, to live.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是唯一能真正令我们心生敬畏的存在。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be feared.

author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quoteCn: 成功，是抵达你所渴望的彼岸；而幸福，则是安然拥抱你已然拥有的一切。
quoteEn: Success is getting what you want. Happiness is wanting what you get.

author: 戴赫·劳伦斯
quoteCn: 灵魂，是唯一能被我们反复叩问、深陷疑虑的真实。
quoteEn: The soul is the only thing that can be doubted.

author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quoteCn: 若你将掌声的源泉寄托于外界，那么你的幸福，便也交由他人保管。
quoteEn: The person who seeks all their applause from outside has their happiness in another’s keeping.

author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quoteCn: 与人相处，请铭记：我们面对的并非冰冷的逻辑，而是涌动的情感。
quoteEn: When dealing with people, remember you are not dealing with creatures of logic, but with creatures of emotion.

author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quoteCn: 决定你悲喜的，从来不是你拥有什么、身居何位、身处何境或正在何为，而是你如何看待这一切。
quoteEn: It isn’t what you have or who you are or where you are or what you are doing that makes you happy or unhappy. It is what you think about it.

author: 戴尔·卡耐基
quoteCn: 恐惧，不过是心头幻象。
quoteEn: Fear doesn’t exist anywhere except in the mind.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 拖延的困境在于，那是一场与内在自我的无声较量。
quoteEn: The problem with procrastination is that it is a battle against ourselves.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 我们不过是棋盘上的卒子，那些操控我们的巨大力量，我们大多终其一生也未能参透。
quoteEn: We are pawns in a game whose forces we largely fail to comprehend.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 当重担压肩，步履维艰时，唯有深植于心的意义，方能点燃我们前行的微光。
quoteEn: The more difficult the task, the more we need to find meaning in it to keep going.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 我们总在适应更好的境遇，然后，将那份好，误以为是寻常。
quoteEn: Human beings adjust to improved circumstances and then consider the new level to be the norm.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 失去的痛楚，在心底的重量，往往是得到欢愉的两倍。
quoteEn: The pain of losing is psychologically about twice as powerful as the pleasure of gaining.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 拥有，不只是占有，更是我们与万物之间，那份无形而深刻的情感羁绊。
quoteEn: The idea of ownership is not just about having something; it’s about the emotional connection we form with it.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 我们做出的每个选择，不只是理智的权衡，更是内心深处情感的涌动与牵引。
quoteEn: We don’t just make decisions based on what we think; we make decisions based on how we feel.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 我们倾注心血越深，越难割舍，即便它早已失去意义，徒留执念。
quoteEn: The more we invest in something, the harder it is to abandon it—even when it no longer makes sense.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 比起对获得的渴望，我们更容易被失去的恐惧所牵引。
quoteEn: We are more motivated by the fear of losing than by the hope of gaining.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 当选择如潮水般涌来，我们反而深陷迷茫，即便做出决定，内心也难寻那份笃定的满足。
quoteEn: The more options we have, the harder it is to choose—and the less satisfied we are with our choice.

author: 丹·阿里里
quoteCn: 我们常凭心而动，再以理服己。
quoteEn: We often make decisions based on emotions, and then use logic to justify them.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 大脑，它首先是为生存而演化出的精巧工具，而非为了探寻那些冰冷、绝对的真理。
quoteEn: The brain is a survival organ, not a truth-seeking organ.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 我们每个人，都是自己故事的引力中心。
quoteEn: The self is a center of narrative gravity.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 要告诉一个人，他穷尽一生所追逐的不过是泡影，从来就没有什么温和的措辞。
quoteEn: There’s simply no polite way to tell people they’ve dedicated their lives to an illusion.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 犯错的艺术，在于不掩饰，尤其不欺骗自己。因为每一次坦诚的面对，都是通往智慧的阶梯。
quoteEn: The chief trick to making good mistakes is not to hide them—especially not from yourself.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 你我皆是故事，大脑编织的，关于我们自己的，永不停歇的叙事。
quoteEn: The self is a story the brain tells itself.

author: 丹尼尔·丹尼特
quoteCn: 宇宙从不曾许诺我们意义，它需要我们亲手去铸就。
quoteEn: The universe doesn’t owe us meaning. We have to create it ourselves.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 情绪的潮汐，总是先于理智的灯塔抵达。
quoteEn: The emotional brain responds to an event more quickly than the thinking brain.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 孩子需要明白，所有的感受都是被允许的，它们没有对错之分；但并非所有的行为，都能被社会温柔接纳。
quoteEn: The basic premise that children must learn about emotions is that all feelings are okay, but not all behaviors are okay.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 情感的洪流总是先于理智的堤坝，它以迅雷不及掩耳之势奔涌而出，不留一丝喘息去审视自己的轨迹。
quoteEn: The emotional brain is much quicker than the rational brain, springing into action without pausing even a moment to consider what it is doing.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 共情，是那份能将自我沉浸于他人内在世界，去思其所思，感其所感的深邃能力。
quoteEn: Empathy is the capacity to think and feel oneself into the inner life of another person.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 我们内里住着两个灵魂：一个负责理性思量，另一个则沉溺于感性流淌。
quoteEn: In a very real sense, we have two minds, one that thinks and one that feels.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 我们对显而易见的事物常常视而不见，更可怕的是，我们甚至意识不到自己的这份盲目。
quoteEn: We can be blind to the obvious, and we are also blind to our blindness.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 未来变幻莫测，这本是常识，可我们总能轻而易举地回溯过往，为一切找到合理解释，仿佛这般回溯，便能消解未来的不确定，这本身就是一种深刻的讽刺与人性的执念。
quoteEn: The idea that the future is unpredictable is undermined every day by the ease with which the past is explained.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 你此刻所执着的一切，其重要性远不如你想象中那般不可或缺。放下吧，生命自有其轻盈。
quoteEn: Nothing in life is as important as you think it is while you are thinking about it.

author: 丹尼尔·戈尔曼
quoteCn: 情绪之脑，是激情与灵感的摇篮，亦是我们最深层非理性恐惧和毁灭性冲动的源头。
quoteEn: The emotional brain is the seat of passion and inspiration, and it is also the source of our most irrational fears and destructive impulses.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 情绪的尾巴，摇曳着理性的身躯。
quoteEn: The emotional tail wags the rational dog.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 这世界远比你想象的更混沌无序。你所感知到的所有秩序与连贯，不过是你心智的温柔编织。
quoteEn: The world makes much less sense than you think. The coherence comes mostly from the way your mind works.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 人心擅长编织故事，却不总能道出真相。它在自欺与自洽间游走，有时是温柔的谎言，有时是残酷的现实。
quoteEn: The mind is good at telling stories, but it does not always tell the truth.

author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
quoteCn: 我们总以为自己懂了，殊不知，那份“懂得”常常只是大脑编织的幻象，如此普遍，又如此难以察觉。
quoteEn: The illusion of understanding is one of the most pervasive cognitive illusions.

author: 丹尼尔·瓦萨洛
quoteCn: 别让外界的喧嚣，掩盖了你内心深处那份独有的声音。
quoteEn: Don’t let the noise of others’ opinions drown out your own inner voice.

author: 大卫·艾伦
quoteCn: 最大的困扰莫过于，那些你此刻无力改变的事，却在脑海中循环往复，挥之不去。
quoteEn: The big problem is that your mind keeps reminding you of things when you can’t do anything about them.

author: 大卫·艾伦
quoteCn: 你生命的光泽，与你安然松弛的本事，息息相关。
quoteEn: The quality of your life is directly proportional to your ability to relax.

author: 大卫·艾伦
quoteCn: 何必让思绪重复徘徊，除非你沉溺于那份回味。生命短暂，别让无谓的念头占据你的当下，除非那份沉溺本身，就是你此刻的自由。
quoteEn: There is no reason to ever have the same thought twice, unless you like having that thought.
